import sys, importlib

def load(path, name):
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); return m

print("csvfix parse 4col:", cf.parse("a,b,c,d"))
print("csvfix parse 3col spaced:", cf.parse(' a , 2 , x '))
print("csvfix total empty list:", cf.total([]))

# rules
r = load('rules/engine.py','r')
print("rules all empty:", r.evaluate({"all": []}, {}))
print("rules any empty:", r.evaluate({"any": []}, {}))
print("rules unknown:", r.evaluate({"nope": ["a"]}, {"a": True}))

# ledger
l = load('ledger/ledger.py','l')
try:
    l.Ledger().apply([("deposit","b",-1)], "a")   # negative on other account

except ValueError as e:
    print("ledger other-account negative: ValueError", e)

# schedule
s = load('schedule/schedule.py','s')
print("schedule gap==minutes (no merge):", s.slots([(0,10),(15,20)], 5))
print("schedule gap<minutes (merge):", s.slots([(0,10),(15,20)], 6))

print("schedule nested:", s.slots([(0,50),(10,20)], 0))

# intervals
